beats.speech: Stop saying very cute. Here are four better words.
Adorable: extremely cute. An adorable puppy.
Cuddly: soft and nice to hug. A cuddly teddy bear.
Charming: pleasant and attractive. A charming little village.
Lovable: warm and easy to like. A lovable old dog.
Which word will you use? Comment your own word for very cute!
